name: browser-lanes
description: See which session owns the Playwright browser, coordinate access between agents and close leftover browsers when they are no longer needed.
sourceDescription: Shows if this session has a Playwright browser and who holds it. /browser clean closes leftover browsers. A subagent that wants the browser waits until the one using it is done.
author: Hamza Zafar

category.label: Web Mods
category.basis: Supports browser use, search or web previews.
